_label: Simulated HCA structure: grounded observations + clearly-qualified structural credit findings referencing real node/link ids; a simulated guarantor finding (neutral, qualified) and a cash-flow-access finding reported as insufficient evidence. Senior-management observation preserved.

hypotheses.claim: The board oversees governance and succession planning.

evidence_quotes.quote: The board of directors oversees governance and succession planning

borrower_identification.limitation: No proposed borrowing entity is identified from transaction evidence.

structural_credit_findings.credit_hypothesis: The designated borrower sits below two holding-company layers, so structural proximity to operating assets depends on evidence not shown in the diagram.
structural_credit_findings.causal_mechanism: Holding-company layers above the borrower can place operating-subsidiary creditors ahead of claims on the borrower, but only where subsidiary-level debt and the absence of upstream guarantees are established by evidence.
structural_credit_findings.structural_observation: The borrower node sits beneath the ultimate parent and an intermediate holding company.
downstream_verification_requirements: Confirm subsidiary-level debt and guarantee structure with SO.
qualifications: Structural subordination is not inferred from holding-company layers alone; required debt/guarantee evidence is absent.

structural_credit_findings.credit_hypothesis: Several operating subsidiaries carry a guarantor marking in the simulated structure; whether they guarantee any proposed borrowing is not established.
structural_credit_findings.causal_mechanism: Guarantor coverage of operating subsidiaries could mitigate structural subordination, but a marking in a simulated diagram does not establish an enforceable guarantee of the proposed facility.
structural_credit_findings.structural_observation: Five nodes carry a guarantor marking, including operating subsidiaries.
downstream_verification_requirements: Obtain guarantor schedule and credit agreement from SO.
qualifications: The structure is simulated; a simulated guarantor marking is not verified legal protection and no enforceable guarantee is established.
missing_information: Which obligations, if any, the marked entities guarantee, and any coverage limits or exclusions.

structural_credit_findings.credit_hypothesis: Upstream cash access from operating subsidiaries to the borrower cannot be assessed from ownership percentages alone.
structural_credit_findings.causal_mechanism: Even wholly-owned subsidiaries may face dividend, covenant, statutory or minority restrictions that limit upstream distributions; none are shown in the diagram.
structural_credit_findings.structural_observation: Ownership links are shown, but no distribution-restriction evidence is present.
downstream_verification_requirements: Obtain dividend and intercompany-transfer restrictions from SO.
qualifications: Ownership percentage alone does not establish unrestricted cash access.
missing_information: Dividend restrictions, debt covenants and intercompany-transfer limits.

management_assessments.hypothesis: The board oversees governance and succession planning.
management_assessments.credit_mechanism: Board oversight of succession may reduce leadership continuity risk.

information_gaps: Subsidiary-level debt, guarantees and distribution restrictions are not disclosed.
